messages:
mira: Quick sync — I'm onboarding devin as a shadower this weekend. Need to lock coverage for Sat/Sun (Jun 22/23). Who's free to take primary/backup slots?

cal: I can do Sat evening (18:00-02:00 UTC) primary.

devin: happy to shadow any slot. prefer afternoons so i'm awake :)

mira: rough proposal:
- Sat 08:00-16:00 UTC primary=devin (shadowing), backup=cal
- Sat 16:00-00:00 UTC primary=cal, backup=mira
- Sun 00:00-08:00 UTC primary=mira, backup=devin
Can folks ack so I can update rota?

cal: ack.

devin: ack — thanks, mira. excited to pair.

ops-bot: ALERT: Incident INC-7891 created at 1732110500 — elevated 5xx on model-serving-east (severity=P1). Paging <#eng-oncall>.

mira: we'll use this as a live demo for devin. devin, things to watch immediately: 5xx rate, pod restarts, and model fallback loops.

mira: quick runbook snippets (copy these during a page):
```
# check pods and restarts
kubectl get pods -n serving -l pool=model-serving-east -o wide
# stream recent logs
stern model-serving-east -n serving --since 10m
# grafana panels: Serving -> Errors, Queue length (filter pool=model-serving-east)
# mitigation (fast): reduce batch size or add replica
redctl pool scale model-serving-east +1
# to force fallback off (temp): set env var on deployment and rollout
kubectl set env deploy/model-proxy FallbackEnabled=false -n serving && kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-proxy -n serving
```

cal: small note — avoid flipping FallbackEnabled without a follow-up rollback plan. It can spike latency if CPU-bound.

devin: understood. what's the escalation ladder here?

mira: primary pages backup after +5m. if no resolution by +15m escalate to eng-sre and ping on-call leads (@cal, @mira). contact details in runbook.

pagerduty: Reminder: Scheduled shift change at 2024-06-22 08:00 UTC. Primary: devin (shadow), Backup: cal.

mira: handoff checklist for shadowers (we'll run at T-30 before shift):
- confirm PagerDuty phone number and SMS enabled
- ensure SSO access to runbooks & grafana
- pin the active incidents list (`/incidents active`)
- pair 15m with outgoing primary to review any ongoing mitigations
- mark DND off and notifications unmuted on Slack

cal: tip for live pages — if you see repeated 502s in the ingress, check model-variant churn (`variant_switch` logs) and KV cache misses. those correlate with CPU thundering.

devin: good call. mira, can we pair 15m before my first shadow page?

mira: yes — i'll be on at 07:30 UTC to walk through the active dashboards and show a recent mitigation. also will grant devin read access to the private runbook: https://redwood.company/runbooks/oncall/serving (SSO).

cal: ack. one more operational note: avoid restarting whole ReplicaSets unless you've drained traffic; prefer `kubectl scale --replicas=0` + `scale back` for quick cache reset with minimal client disruption.

devin: thanks, that helps. Anything else I should prep?

mira: bring a laptop with terminal + VPN, bookmark grafana panels, and have runbook link open. We'll rehearse a controlled mitigation if a noisy alert hits.

devin: got it. see you both Sat 07:30 UTC. :thumbsup:

mira: thanks team — i'll update rota doc and post final confirmations here after edits.
